About

Good work should look clear and work hard.

I’m Wilberforce Mubiru, a Kampala-based graphic artist, web developer, and brand specialist. My work connects the visual system to the thing it needs to accomplish — a shirt that reads at an event, a website that guides a visitor, or an app that makes a real workflow easier.

The portfolio now keeps those three disciplines together so visitors can understand the range without losing the thread.
